meta.source: Dwarf Fortress (Steam) install, READ ONLY mine

roots.procedural_lua: data/vanilla/vanilla_procedural/scripts/generators/ (creatures.lua, creatures/rcp.lua, creatures/shared_info.lua, interactions*.lua, evil.lua, materials.lua, divine.lua, entities.lua)

meta.note: Modern DF (Steam/v50+) generates forgotten beasts, titans, demons, night creatures, curses and secrets at WORLD GEN time via Lua that EMITS raw token text. vanilla_procedural has no .txt objects; the txt vocabulary is emitted by Lua.

steps: 1. STATIC SEED: [FEATURE_BEAST] [ATTACK_TRIGGER:0:0:2] (2 created wealth) NAME/CASTE_NAME 'forgotten beast' NO_GENDER CARNIVORE DIFFICULTY:10 NATURAL_SKILL melee set 6 LARGE_PREDATOR

2. add_regular_tokens + BIOME:SUBTERRANEAN_WATER (layer_type 0) or SUBTERRANEAN_CHASM; options.spheres = {CAVERNS} + {WATER if water layer} + one random evil sphere; is_evil=true; sickness 'beast sickness'; strong_attack_tweak=true

4. get_random_creature_profile(options) -> weighted pick from random_creature_types (235 profiles; base table pushed by C++, Lua-extendable); is_valid_random_creature gates water/humanoidable/good/beast lists
6. build_procgen_creature(rcp, tbl, options) = build_body_from_rcp + build_description + build_pcg_graphics
build_body_from_rcp: a. body_base_fun[rcp.body_base] -> RCP_* body part list + sets pcg_layering_base (BEAST_INSECT/SPIDER/SCORPION/SNAKE/WORM_LONG/WORM_SHORT/AMORPHOUS/HUMANOID/BIPEDAL_DINOSAUR/QUADRUPED_BULKY/QUADRUPED_SLINKY/FRONT_GRASP/WALRUS) + walk gait variant + base walk speed; QUADRUPED has 1-in-20 to grow SIX_LEGGED or EIGHT_LEGGED
b. rcp.must_have_* parts added unconditionally (wings/tail/shell/trunk/antennae/horns/mandibles/pincers/claw_arms/mantis_arms/stingers/proboscis); otherwise pushed as tweak candidates

c. btc1_tweaks loop; then ONE primary tweak (options.btc) picked from candidates -> tweaks[btc].body() mutates the part list (WINGS, WINGS_FLIGHTLESS, TAIL, SHELL, TRUNK, ANTENNAE, HEAD_HORNS, LARGE_MANDIBLES, SIX_LEGGED, EIGHT_LEGGED, MAKE_HUMANOID, ...)
d. digits: rcp.front_digits/rear_digits (2-5) -> RCP_n_FINGERS/FRONT_TOES/REAR_TOES; hoof/paw BODYGLOSS

e. MATERIAL CLASS: options.r_class = rcp.c_class; 1-in-20 flip to UNIFORM for any non-uniform class (or forced by sphere_rcm for titans/demons/angels, blocked by never_uniform for bogeymen/nightmares); r_class_table = random_creature_class[r_class] merges features (eyes/heart/guts/blood...) into options

f. secondary tweak btc2 from r_class tweaks + evil_tweaks (SKINLESS, BEAK_MISSING, NOSE_MISSING, RIBS_EXTERNAL, LIDLESS_EYES) + good_tweaks + eye variants (NO_EYES/ONE_EYE/THREE_EYES); default TWO_EYES otherwise
g. glowing eyes 1-in-10 (werebeasts always): [GLOWTILE][GLOWCOLOR] + bright eye color
h. forced stingers/proboscis at 1-in-20 each -> attack_tweak = TAIL_STINGER / INSECT_STINGER / PROBOSCIS_BLOOD
j. surface tweak (HAIR/FEATHERS/SCALES/SKIN/SKIN_BONES/EXOSKELETON/SKINLESS) emits USE_MATERIAL_TEMPLATE/USE_TISSUE_TEMPLATE + STATE_COLOR; horn/shell templates if present

k. r_class body_plan: [BODY_DETAIL_PLAN:VERTEBRATE_TISSUE_LAYERS:SKIN|SCALE|NONE:FAT:MUSCLE:BONE:CARTILAGE] or [EXOSKELETON_TISSUE_LAYERS:CHITIN|SKIN:FAT:MUSCLE] + SINEW tendons/ligaments + HAS_NERVES; UNIFORM instead emits one TISSUE:UNIFORM_TIS over the WHOLE body from the picked material

l. UNIFORM material pick: random_creature_material table (18 families) alignment-gated; sphere-linked via sphere_random_creature_materials (DEATH->ASH, FIRE->ASH|FLAME, CAVERNS->ANY_MINERAL...) or ANY_MINERAL = random SPECIAL-flagged inorganic from the world's stone/gem/metal list
m. [NOBREATHE] + [EXTRAVISION] if UNIFORM; HOMEOTHERM:10040 unless fixed_temp (snow/ice 9990, steam 10200, flame 25000); blood = BLOOD/ICHOR/GOO template via heart artery layer
n. color pick from monotone color patterns, sphere-aware (DEATH/MISERY->grays/blacks, DARKNESS/NIGHT->dark blues); [STATE_COLOR:ALL_SOLID:<color>] on surface material; [COLOR:f:b:br]
o. ATTACK TWEAK: strong_attack_tweak (FB/titan/demon) forces pick_random_conditional_pairs(attack_tweaks); apply() emits poison material + syndrome + CDI interaction tokens
p. post_attack_tweaks: melee ATTACK tokens by body part (PUNCH on RCP_TWO_PART_ARMS, SNATCH on pincers/claw arms, bites, tail attacks)

q. gaits: [APPLY_CREATURE_VARIATION:STANDARD_SWIMMING_GAITS:...] unless cannot_swim; STANDARD_FLYING_GAITS + [FLIER] if wings; walk variant by body base; STANDARD_CRAWLING_GAITS always; STANDARD_CLIMBING_GAITS if any climbing part
r. pcg_layering extras: QUILLS/PLATES 1-in-5 (or forced by profile), EXTERNAL_RIBS, BEAK layer for snake/dino/humanoid bases, MANDIBLES layers; 5 decoration slots coin-flipped
assembly_chain_forgotten_beast.build_description: [DESCRIPTION: size adjective + btc/btc2 adjectives + rcp.name_string + form_desc (twisted_desc if evil) + post_mat_adj 'composed of X' + flavor line (default/good/evil pools, sphere-gated) + 'Its eyes glow <color>' + attack tweak warning 'Beware its webs/fire/deadly dust!'] + [PREFSTRING:...] + optional [ODOR_STRING]/[ODOR_LEVEL:90]
assembly_chain_forgotten_beast.build_pcg_graphics: [PROCEDURAL_CREATURE_GRAPHICS:DEFAULT] + ordered [PCG_LAYERING:BEAST_*] (base, decorations, wings lacy/feathered/bat BACK|FRONT, shell BACK|FRONT, tail ONE|TWO|THREE, trunk, antennae, horns1/2, quills, plates, external ribs, eyes ONE|TWO|THREE) + [USE_COLOR_PALETTE:<color>] per layer; body_size<=500000 swaps BEAST_* to BEAST_SMALL_*; organic surfaces add BEAST_ORGANIC_* layers; separate portrait pass for experiments

never_repeating_combinatorics.creature_profiles: 235 weighted profiles: insects 44 (w22 each), arachnids 5 (w200-250), crustaceans 3, worms/molluscs 8, amphibians 4, reptiles 25, birds 73, mammals 69, plus GENERAL_BLOB/QUADRUPED/HUMANOID (w1000 each)
never_repeating_combinatorics.material_flip: 1-in-20 any creature becomes UNIFORM (single-material body, 18 material families incl. ANY_MINERAL/GEM/METAL/SOIL drawn from the world's own inorganics)
never_repeating_combinatorics.attack_tweaks: 10 classes x poison state (LIQUID/GAS/SOLID_POWDER) x randomized syndrome (up to 5 of 17 CE_ effects, random severity/timing/organ targeting)
never_repeating_combinatorics.spheres: CAVERNS + WATER + 1 evil sphere per FB; spheres drive color pools, material pools, description flavor
never_repeating_combinatorics.colors: sphere-filtered monotone color patterns for surface + glowing eye color
never_repeating_combinatorics.graphics: layered PCG sprite composition (5 decoration slots, wing type, shell side, tail count, horn count)

MAMMAL.features: eyes nose cheeks lungs heart guts throat spine neck brain skull mouth teeth ribs eyelids tongue blood

CHITIN_EXO.features: eyes heart guts brain mouth ichor

AVIAN.features: beak instead of mouth, no teeth

UNIFORM.body_plan: single TISSUE:UNIFORM_TIS from picked material over ALL body parts, NOT_LIVING NOT_BUTCHERABLE NOBREATHE EXTRAVISION; flame material grants built-in fireball+firejet+FIREEIMMUNE_SUPER

uniform_body_materials._note: random_creature_material table; UNIFORM creatures are 'composed of X'; evil-gated entries only roll for evil creatures
inorganic_pick: ANY_METAL (random SPECIAL-flagged inorganic from world gen list)

matter.SNOW: fixed_temp 9990, INTANGIBLE, possible name suffix ' of tears'
matter.FLAME: fixed_temp 25000, INTANGIBLE, fire_mat -> built-in FIREBALL + FIREJET interactions

attack_tweaks._note: attack_tweaks table shared_info.lua:5092; FB/titan/demon set strong_attack_tweak=true so one is ALWAYS applied (unless good/intangible); spiders force WEBS via must_have_webs

TAIL_STINGER.grants: CREATURE_EXTRACT_TEMPLATE POISON (LIQUID) + syndrome + tail sting attack

INSECT_STINGER.trigger: lower body stinger (wasp/bee profiles forced, or 1-in-20)

FIRE.trigger: has mouth/beak; roll: fireball only, firejet only, or both

BREATHE_TRAILING_FLOW.grants: extract POISON as LIQUID(vapor)/GAS(gas)/SOLID_POWDER(dust) TRAILING_*_FLOW CDI

POISON_BLOOD.grants: poison syndrome on own BLOOD/ICHOR/GOO material

PROBOSCIS_BLOOD.warning: Beware its hunger for warm blood!

poison_system.material_template: CREATURE_EXTRACT_TEMPLATE (material_template_default.txt:2589): white extract; states liquid 'extract', solid 'frozen extract', gas 'boiling extract'; ENTERS_BLOOD; value 1
poison_system.randomization: add_base_poison_effects: 1-5 distinct effects, random start/peak/end windows, 1-in-30 permanent (no END), RESISTABLE 1-in-30, SIZE_DELAYS/SIZE_DILUTES rolls; NECROSIS/IMPAIR_FUNCTION randomly LOCALIZED or organ-targeted (15 organ categories incl. BRAIN, HEART)

list: MATERIAL_EMISSION (creature_action emission; template all generated sprays ride on)

generators: default: resurrect-as-mummy with Curse + Animate corpse + Raise lieutenant sub-interactions
regional.animate (weekly corpse reanimation in evil regions)

vampire_curse.source: I_SOURCE:INGESTION (tainted blood); targets CAN_LEARN+HAS_BLOOD; forbidden NOT_LIVING/SUPERNATURAL; mutually exclusive vs WERECURSE/VAMPCURSE/DISTURBANCE_CURSE/RAISED_UNDEAD/RAISED_GHOST/GHOUL syndrome classes
vampire_curse.grants: SYN_CLASS:VAMPCURSE; BLOODSUCKER NO_AGING STERILE NOT_LIVING NOEXERT NOPAIN NOBREATHE NOSTUN NONAUSEA NO_DIZZINESS NO_FEVERS PARALYZEIMMUNE NO_EAT NO_DRINK NO_SLEEP NO_PHYS_ATT_GAIN/RUST; STR/AGI/TOU doubled (200); CE_MATERIAL_FORCE_MULTIPLIER 1:2 (takes half damage); own blood becomes infectious vector (CE_BODY_MAT_INTERACTION RESERVED_BLOOD, spread via ingested/injected); tooth length +150% (fangs, gated on COUNTER_TRIGGER:DRINKING_BLOOD); display name 'vampire'; senses GENERAL_POISON class

necromancy_secret.source: IS_SECRET:SUPERNATURAL_LEARNING_POSSIBLE + mundane research/teaching/recording (BOOK_INSTRUCTION:SECRET_DEATH); goal IMMORTALITY; sphere DEATH (+NIGHTMARES if summoner)
necromancy_secret.grants: SYN_CLASS:NECROMANCER; NO_AGING NO_EAT NO_DRINK NO_SLEEP NOEXERT NO_PHYS_ATT_GAIN/RUST (+NIGHT_CREATURE_EXPERIMENTER 1-in-3); personality flip (anxiety +50, trust -50); CDI Animate corpse; THEN at least one of: Raise lieutenant (resurrects corpses as RAISED_UNDEAD servants with lieutenant powers; named from 33 adjectives x 8 nouns, e.g. 'fell ghoul'), Summon bogeymen/nightmare (SUMMON_UNIT by caste flag, cooldown 200-300 / 12000), Create ghoul (EXPERIMENT_ONLY contagious bite, OPPOSED_TO_LIFE, random speed debuff); ghost-raising code present but disabled (if false)

were_curse.grants: SYN_CLASS:WERECURSE; CE_BODY_TRANSFORMATION to the generated werebeast creature token; CE:PERIODIC:MOON_PHASE:27:0 (full moon); NO_AGING; deity-source immediate, bite-source delayed START:16800 (~16 days); same mutual-exclusion block; the werebeast ITSELF is an RCP creature (beast_only, humanoidable_only, prioritize_bite, CRAZED, NO_GENDER, BONECARN, combat skills 6, SNEAK 20, DIFFICULTY 3, LAIR SIMPLE_BURROW) with a per-world profile blacklist so were-forms never repeat

mummy_disturbance.grants: resurrect as mummy (STR/TOU 300, NOT_LIVING full undead tag set, vengeful +100 personality); carries 3 CDIs: Curse (week-long CE_SKILL_ROLL_ADJUST PERC:0 PERC_ON:20), Animate corpse, Raise <adjective noun> lieutenant; names from 13 tomb adjectives x 8 nouns

deity_minor_medium.bad_luck: CE_SKILL_ROLL_ADJUST PERC:0 PERC_ON:20, one week (8400 ticks)
deity_minor_medium.become_beast: CE_BODY_TRANSFORMATION into random NATURAL_ANIMAL (megabeast/demon/etc forbidden) one week + NO_AGING/NO_EAT/NO_DRINK + fast effortless gait
deity_minor_medium.holy_item: CREATE_ITEM artifact-quality weapon (1/3) / shield (1/3) / armor piece
deity_minor_medium.pet: SUMMON_UNIT random LARGE_PREDATOR natural animal, IE_MAKE_PET_IF_POSSIBLE
deity_minor_medium.healing: full CE heal bundle (STOP_BLEEDING, CLOSE_OPEN_WOUNDS, HEAL_TISSUES, HEAL_NERVES, REGROW_PARTS, CURE_INFECTION, reduce pain/swelling/paralysis...) 12-tick burst

lieutenant_powers: raise fog (CHANGE_WEATHER FOG_THICK) + randomized curse touches (PAIN/BLISTERS/PARALYSIS/BLEEDING/SICKEN/NECROSIS/IMPAIR/DIZZY)
grants_detail.evil_region_weather: evil.lua: clouds named '<adj> mist/dust/ash/soot/fog/gloom/murk/smoke/vapor' (19 adjectives); 50% living-death (husk/zombie/thrall renaming + full undead tag set) else poison burst; evil rain '<adj> slime/goo/mucus/ooze/sludge/filth/muck/slush' (18 adjectives) mild poison

creature_variation_static_weaving._note: the ANIMAL_PERSON / GIANT side: static CV templates in vanilla_creatures/objects/c_variation_default.txt applied to real animals (the procedural Lua path handles megabeasts; CV handles animal people)
creature_variation_static_weaving.ANIMAL_PERSON_chain: CV_REMOVE_TAG x49 (NAME/PET/ATTACK*/GAIT/VERMIN_*/MAXAGE/SPEED...) + CV_CONVERT_TAG body swaps (QUADRUPED->HUMANOID, QUADRUPED_NECK->HUMANOID_NECK:3FINGERS, ...) + civ-level additions (CAN_LEARN CAN_SPEAK)
creature_variation_static_weaving.GIANT_variation: same strip + size multiplier, keeps animal body
